nonclaims: A fresh-narrator capsule is a locally authenticated context artifact, not proof that a provider erased memory, denied all tools, or isolated a worker.
A distinct context ID, Temporary Chat, API call, or named subagent is a host declaration unless independently attested.
The capsule excludes rejected candidate artifacts by construction, but a hostile parent or provider may still leak information outside the declared protocol.
A same-context ChatGPT roleplay remains useful for play and protocol rehearsal; it is not the clean information-bottleneck treatment.
The compressed state card remains private planning guidance rather than player-observed canon, and its artistic sufficiency remains an empirical question.
The scenario and bundle machinery makes the comparison falsifiable and replayable; it does not report a completed multi-provider study or prove that retcon planning improves fiction.
Database integrity, schema validity, and passing receipts do not prove narrative quality, semantic entailment, rater independence, or provider identity.

Lacuna does not retain full transcript bodies; a capsule-only treatment assumes continuity-critical observed canon was typed, while transcript-parity studies must separately bind equal player-visible history across conditions.
